# Shelf

> Anime and manga discovery with advanced filtering, statistics, and optional personal tracking.

## Public pages

- [Shelf — Discover anime and manga](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/)
- [Advanced anime search — Shelf](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/search)
- [Random anime picker — Shelf](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/random)
- [Anime catalog statistics — Shelf](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/stats)
- [Advanced manga search — Shelf](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/manga)
- [Manga catalog statistics — Shelf](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/manga/stats)
- [Anime character quiz — Shelf](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/quiz)
- [Shelf changelog](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/changelog)
- [Shelf catalog updates](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/catalog-updates)

- [Shelf privacy](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/privacy)
- [Shelf terms](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/terms)
- [Shelf MCP setup](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/mcp)

## Catalog collections

- Anime detail: https://anime.significanthobbies.com/anime/{malId} and https://anime.significanthobbies.com/anime/{malId}.md
- Manga detail: https://anime.significanthobbies.com/manga/{malId} and https://anime.significanthobbies.com/manga/{malId}.md
